notes: PURPOSE (vegetable slate 2026-08-31): the moisture vehicle among the veg adds - ~95% water, ~17 kcal/100 g, raw-recipe friendly (grated raw). Complements pumpkin/butternut's soluble-fiber role; green beans (insoluble-fiber bulk) queued after this.
FRAME: includes skin, raw - FND 2685568 and SR 169291 share it. FND is the SAME 2023 Foundation produce study as butternut's 2685570 (sibling coherence, like the 10048/10054 chicken pair).

PLANT-ZERO conventions (butternut 10019 precedent): taurine 0 = biochemical zero via literature row (Spitze plant survey); SR vitamin D 0 and B12 0 are TRUE zeros for produce, keep sr_legacy - do NOT treat as unpopulated-zero suspects (that rule's false-positive audit was about meats).

Iodine expectation: butternut stored 0.5 µg (<LOD convention, all tables). iodine_db 11478 covers zucchini itself this time (boiled frame - cooked-frame caveat, plausibility anchor like breast's 05064).

FCDB naming quirk: Danish 'Squash, raw' (56) IS courgette/zucchini - butternut and kuri are named separately in FCDB, confirming. If its values read butternut-like (~45 kcal), treat as a mis-key and drop.
Siblings for anchors: 10019 butternut (validated sweep + Foundation reconciliation; chloride 28, iodine 0.5), 10036 pumpkin. Expect zucchini chloride ~ CoFID courgette measurement.

fcdb.note: Squash, raw - Danish 'squash' = courgette/zucchini (butternut/kuri separately named); Danish analytical, expect n's on minerals

mext.note: Zucchini, fruit, raw - Japanese analytical; total-K = K1 for plants (no menaquinone concern in produce)

ciqual.note: Courgette, chair et peau, crue - flesh AND skin, exact frame match; echo screen decides independence

cofid.note: Courgette, raw - UK; chloride + biotin carrier (the two SR gaps CoFID usually fills); cite underlying survey from refs

afcd.note: Zucchini, green skin, fresh, unpeeled, raw - exact frame; check Derivation flag for borrows

iodine_db.note: Squash, summer, zucchini, fresh/frozen, boiled - COOKED frame, plausibility anchor; veg iodine typically <LOD (butternut convention 0.5)

literature.note: Plants carry no taurine - biochemical zero, not unmeasured (Spitze 2003 plant survey found none beyond trace in a few items). Butternut 10019 convention.
